title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: A hunter who kills a wolf to feed her family is dragged across a border into a faerie court as payment. What begins as captivity grows into a love story, then into a fight against a curse that threatens everything.
readIf: You like fairy-tale retellings with a lush setting and a romance at the centre.
skipIf: You want a self-contained story, since this opens a long series, or you dislike controlling love interests.

pairings.reason: A faster, more brutal read with a similar mix of danger, rivalry and romance.
A gentler way to cleanse the palate: magic and a growing bond, without the peril.
